identity_verification_semantics: BIBLIOGRAPHIC_IDENTITY_RECORDED_FROM_RESEARCH_AUTHORITY is identity-only. It does not certify claim inspection, full text access, or passage evidence.

status_semantics.evidence_status: Use an explicit evidence_status/evidenceStatus from the owning source record. If absent, emit NOT_EXPLICITLY_LABELED. Never substitute access state.
status_semantics.inspection_scope: The exact depth recorded by the owning lane; it must not be inherited across claims merely because source_id matches.

owner_resolution.MATCHING_OVERRIDE_QUORUM: A candidate's latest override layer explicitly matches a quorum lane that owns the same source ID.
owner_resolution.BASE_LEDGER_NO_DEPTH_INHERITANCE: No matching override quorum owns this claim; use the base ledger record and do not inherit a later/deeper lane merely because source_id matches.
owner_resolution.SOLE_EXPLICIT_SOURCE_LANE: The source exists in exactly one explicit source-control lane.

fail_closed_conditions: multiple same-layer quorum owners for one candidate/source edge
multiple ledger identity owners with no unambiguous authority
multiple quorum inspection lanes with no provenance match and no base owner
product card cannot identify an owning inspection lane
